data.name: Tofu Drive
data.detailed_description:
Tofu Drive

You play as the owner of a family tofu shop in 1990s Japan.

A local street racing gang burns down your tofu shop. You must rebuild a rusted delivery car. To get revenge for your shop, you have to learn how to fix cars, build engines, and race the gang members on the local mountain passes.

Buy parts, build your engine, and race to get your revenge.

Key Features

Detailed Car Mechanic System

  • Body Work: Remove damaged doors, replace dented hoods, and strip the chassis bare.

  • Engine Building: You don't just swap engines; you rebuild them. Take apart the engine block, change pistons, use aggressive camshafts install custom intakes

Pink Slip Street Racing Race your custom car on dangerous mountain roads at night. Beat lower-level gang members to earn money for new car parts and get their keys. Work your way up the ranks until you face the bosses who burned down your shop.

90s Japan Setting The game features a 1990s Japanese aesthetic. Listen to music on your car radio and drive through areas filled with neon vending machines and underground street racing culture.

Rebuild Your Shop Use the money you win from street racing to slowly rebuild your family's tofu shop. Every race you win brings you closer to getting your business back and defeating the gang.
